newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sales of Toyota new minivan exceed target.
newsitem.headline: Sales of Toyota new minivan exceed target.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Wednesday that it received a total of 10,000 orders for its new TownAce Noah and LiteAce Noah recreational vehicles in the first seven days after their launch.
Toyota had launched the two minivans in Japan with a total monthly sales target of 6,500 units.

Kazushi Iwatsuki, Toyota's director in charge of domestic vehicle sales, said last Wednesday that monthly orders for the LiteAce Noah and TownAce Noah could initially reach 20,000 units after their launch.
